attchmntText: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 72,728 equity shares under ADS Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2004, 11,298 equity shares under the Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2007 and 11,477 equity shares under Employee Stock Options, Performance Stock Unit and Restricted Stock Unit Scheme 2024 on November 4, 2026, pursuant to exercise of ESOPs.
Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange about intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Grant of ADS-RSUs'.

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange to please refer to our earlier letter dated October 16, 2026, informing that Wipro Limited through its step-down subsidiary - Wipro IT Services, LLC had signed a definitive agreement to acquire 20% shareholding in FLARRE.AI, Inc. and that the transaction was expected to be completed by October 31, 2026.In continuation to the aforesaid letter, it is hereby informed that the said transaction has been completed on October 28, 2026.The Company received intimation to this effect on October 29, 2026.

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 84,758 equity shares under ADS Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2004, 21,168 equity shares under the Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2007 and 1,20,070 equity shares under Employee Stock Options, Performance Stock Unit and Restricted Stock Unit Scheme 2024 on October 27, 2026, pursuant to exercise of ESOPs.
Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of the Analyst / Institutional Investor Meeting held on October 15, 2026.
Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Advertisement - Regulation 47 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and para 202.05 read with para 202.06 of the NYSE Listed Company Manual, it is hereby informed that Wipro Limited through its step-down subsidiary - Wipro IT Services, LLC has signed a definitive agreement to acquire 20% shareholding in FLARRE.AI, Inc. on October 15, 2026.

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that the audio and video recording of the earnings press conference held on October 15, 2026 is available on the Company s website at https://www.wipro.com/newsroom/press-releases/2026/wipro-press-conference-q2-fy-2026-2027/

Wipro Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Trading Window closure pursuant to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, it is informed that merger of Wipro VLSI Design Services, LLC (step-down subsidiary) into Wipro IT Services, LLC (step-down subsidiary) is completed and is effective from October 1, 2026 (Eastern Time). The Company received intimation to this effect on October 3, 2026.

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 90,686 equity shares under the Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2007 and 6,418 equity shares under Employee Stock Options, Performance Stock Unit and Restricted Stock Unit Scheme 2024, respectively, on October 1, 2026.

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange to please refer to our earlier letters dated April 15, 2026, June 23, 2026, and September 30, 2026, respectively informing that Wipro Limited, through its subsidiaries, had signed a definitive agreement to acquire select customer contracts of Alpha Net Consulting LLC and its subsidiaries and that the transaction was expected to be completed by December 31, 2026.In continuation to the aforesaid letters, it is hereby informed that the said transaction has been completed on October 1, 2026.

Wipro Limited has informed the Exchange to please refer to our earlier letters dated April 15, 2026, and June 23, 2026, respectively informing that Wipro Limited, through its subsidiaries, had signed a definitive agreement to acquire select customer contracts of Alpha Net Consulting LLC and its subsidiaries and that the transaction was expected to be completed by September 30, 2026.In continuation to the aforesaid letters, it is hereby informed that the transaction is now expected to be completed at the latest by December 31, 2026.
